recommendation: Keep the commit. It finishes the applied EpisodeOfCare patient-to-subject/group change without removing the deliberate patient search parameter or historical fhir.ini aliases. Related family/group tickets should remain separate per-artifact reconciliations.
issue_request: FHIR-41400 was Applied/Persuasive for R6 by Patient Administration. It asked for EpisodeOfCare.patient to be renamed to subject, for the subject to support Patient and Group, and for search parameters to be updated including an added subject search parameter, matching the Encounter precedent.
initial_application: The historical FHIR-41400 commits 58df91709e and ad64f69d78 applied the main model and search parameter changes: EpisodeOfCare.subject exists, targets Patient and Group, the subject search parameter exists, and the patient search parameter now filters EpisodeOfCare.subject to Patient. They also updated some narrative. Residual patient-only resource summaries, careManager wording, resource-guide text, and the checked-in diagram remained.
additional_context: PA September 2023 WGM minutes record that Encounter already supported groups and PA would add the same support to EpisodeOfCare, with the FHIR-41400 motion passing 4-0-0. source/fhir.ini actively includes EpisodeOfCare; the fhir.ini EpisodeOfCare.patient aliases are migration/diff mappings to EpisodeOfCare.subject and not live patient elements. The broader family/group ticket cluster spans other artifacts and work groups, so those issues were not decided here.
reconciliation: Published a source-changing commit that updates EpisodeOfCare StructureDefinition resource-level summary/root definition and careManager text, synchronizes the EpisodeOfCare Event mapping exception text, updates episodeofcare.svg from EpisodeOfCare.patient/Patient to EpisodeOfCare.subject/Patient|Group, and updates source/resourceguide.html to describe EpisodeOfCare as patient-or-group based.
source_changes: source/episodeofcare/structuredefinition-EpisodeOfCare.xml: generalized the resource description/root definition from patient-only to patient/group and changed careManager wording to this episode of care.
source/episodeofcare/episodeofcare-event-mapping-exceptions.xml: kept careManager mapping exception text synchronized with the StructureDefinition wording.
source/episodeofcare/episodeofcare.svg: updated the diagram link/label from EpisodeOfCare.patient Patient to EpisodeOfCare.subject Patient|Group and refreshed the careManager title.
source/resourceguide.html: updated the EpisodeOfCare resource guide summary from patient-only to patient or group and referred to the ongoing care subject.

related_jiras.note: Encounter subject wording was clarified earlier to describe a patient or group related to an Encounter, informing the Encounter precedent cited by FHIR-41400.
Earlier Appointment/Encounter work added Group among related actor/subject patterns; useful background for the 'Encounter already supports groups' rationale, but not decided here.

evidence_items.learned: This confirms the intended scope is EpisodeOfCare Patient/Group support, not unrelated family/group resource tickets.

evidence_items.locator: Zulip and Confluence searches for FHIR-41400 and family/group terms
evidence_items.command: bun run zulip:search sql "SELECT id, stream_name, topic, sender_name, datetime(timestamp, 'unixepoch') AS sent_at, substr(content, 1, 200) AS excerpt FROM messages WHERE content LIKE '%FHIR-41400%' OR (content LIKE '%EpisodeOfCare%' AND content LIKE '%group%' AND content LIKE '%family%') ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 20"; bun run confluence:search refs jira FHIR-41400; bun run confluence:search fts '"Encounter already supports groups"' --limit 10
evidence_items.query: FHIR-41400 EpisodeOfCare family group subject; Encounter already supports groups
evidence_items.summary: No directly relevant Zulip discussion was found; Confluence returned the family/group ticket review page and PA minutes for the FHIR-41400 motion.
evidence_items.learned: Community evidence supported the Jira/source conclusion and did not reveal a conflicting later decision.

evidence_items.locator: Targeted validation for FHIR-41400 source changes
evidence_items.command: xmllint --noout source/episodeofcare/structuredefinition-EpisodeOfCare.xml source/episodeofcare/episodeofcare-event-mapping-exceptions.xml source/episodeofcare/episodeofcare.svg; git -c core.whitespace=blank-at-eol,blank-at-eof,space-before-tab,cr-at-eol diff --check; rg -n 'EpisodeOfCare\.(patient|subject)|episodeofcare-definitions\.html#EpisodeOfCare\.(patient|subject)' source/episodeofcare source/resourceguide.html source/fhir.ini

evidence_items.learned: The reconciliation is syntactically safe and did not leave an old EpisodeOfCare.patient diagram/source anchor in the EpisodeOfCare source.
